summary: Korea Electric Power Corporation filed a Form 6-K clarifying a September 3, 2026 Herald Business report on a South Korean government energy overhaul. The Korean Government's Plan for Functional Reform of Public Institutions proposes merging KEPCO's five power generation subsidiaries into a single entity, alongside combining oil and gas firms. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or timetable terms were disclosed; KEPCO will re-disclose specifics when determined or within three months. The proposal is a state-directed reorganization with no shareholder vote mechanics specified, creating uncertainty over subsidiary structure, governance, minority stakes, and nuclear/fuel procurement. Watch for the binding restructuring plan, approval path, asset transfers, and any minority-holder or creditor implications.
